issues.description: The Lecture getters getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() are declared private in the solution implementation but the exercise and tests require public getters for every attribute. Problem statement: asks students to "Implement getters for each attribute" (public access). Solution repository: declares these two methods as private (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java). This visibility mismatch will prevent test code or students from calling these getters and will lead to compilation/access failures when the public API is expected.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the getters public so they match the problem statement and expected tests. In solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java change the declarations
  - private String getLectureName() -> public String getLectureName()
  - private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents() -> public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()
Verify other getters are public as well so the class API matches the exercise description.
